# SD18 deterministic Human Barbarian level 13 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Barbarian
# level-1..level-12 martial chassis baseline
# (tests/sd18_barbarian_level12_widening.rs) to level 13 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-12
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. 13th
# level is NOT a rage-power level (powers land at 2/4/6/8/10/12/14 per "she
# gains another rage power for every two levels of barbarian attained after
# 2nd level"), so no seventh numbered slot's choice line is added; the sixth
# slot's line from the level-12 fixture carries over unchanged.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Barbarian burden surface: no rage
# execution (activation, round tracking, fatigue), no rage-power EFFECT
# recognition or execution beyond the bounded numbered-slot idiom, no
# damage-reduction application engine, and no level-14+ progression. The
# PF1 Core Rulebook Barbarian class table's level-13 "Special" column reads
# "Damage reduction 3/-" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the
# Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror): Damage Reduction is a tier-rise
# on the already-grounded Damage Reduction flat-magnitude pillar (a third
# named tier, mirroring the level-7/level-10 two-tier idiom exactly); Trap
# Sense stays +4 (13 / 3, next rise 15th) and base saves stay unchanged from
# level 12 (13 / 2 + 2 = 8, 13 / 3 = 4, both integer-division coincidences),
# so no new pillar beyond the third Damage Reduction tier is grounded.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-barbarian-level13
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:barbarian:13
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:16
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:barbarian_rage_power_6:power:superstition
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
